svg.title: Human chromosome 2 fusion
svg.desc: Two ancestral acrocentric chromosomes join end to end at their short-arm telomeres. The resulting dicentric chromosome can be unstable while both centromeres are active. The second centromere becomes inactive (dashed collar). Human chromosome 2 has one active centromere and retains DNA at the ancestral site. Band lengths are schematic. The three fused bodies share the same length, band order, and ancestry.
